common.tagline: Finnish summer, slow travel & local stays

hero.title: Discover Finland's Endless Summer Nights
hero.subtitle: By the lake, in the sauna and beneath the midnight sun, Finnish summer becomes an experience.
hero.description: Sleep by the water, swim in the evening light, warm up the sauna and let the day drift deep into the night. Discover cottage escapes, city weekends and archipelago adventures.
hero.microcopy: No package tours. Just authentic places, experiences and a direct connection to local providers.

summerHome.title: How do you want your Finnish summer to feel?
summerHome.subtitle: Choose your rhythm: a peaceful cottage, a lively city break or the magic of the midnight sun.
summerHome.midnightDesc: Music, festivals, dancing and the midnight sun.
summerHome.saunaDesc: Steam, cold water and authentic Finnish sauna culture.
summerHome.citiesDesc: Helsinki, Turku and Tampere blend culture, food and long Nordic evenings.
summerHome.cabinsDesc: Your own pier, forest paths and quiet mornings beside the water.
summerHome.storyTitle: In Finland, summer is an experience, not just a season.
summerHome.storyText: When the sun lingers near the horizon for almost the whole night, the day does not need to end. A boat ride can become a midnight swim, the grill can be lit again and the sauna waits by the shore. Come and spend a summer that stays with you.
summerHome.advisorTitle: What kind of summer experience are you looking for?
summerHome.advisorText: Cottage, city or endless nights? The Finnish summer advisor helps you find your next idea.
summerHome.findTitle: What kind of Finland are you looking for?
summerHome.findText: You don't have to know where to go yet. Start with how you want your journey to feel.
summerHome.archipelagoDesc: Islands, sea, boating and quiet coastal villages.
summerHome.natureDesc: National parks, forests, lakes and silence.
summerHome.foodDesc: Fish, campfire salmon, berries, cider and local food.
summerHome.whyText: In southern Finland, archipelago islands, smoke saunas, endless summer light and local life create a slower kind of escape.
summerHome.smokeDesc: Smoke sauna, swimming and a quiet Finnish evening.
summerHome.stayDesc: Glass igloos, boutique hotels, villas and archipelago stays.
summerHome.tasteDesc: Campfire salmon, local cider, craft beer and open-fire food.
summerHome.summerTitle: When the sun doesn't want to leave
summerHome.summerText: Sauna, swim, paddle, fish and dine outdoors late into the evening. In Finnish summer, the day doesn't end at sunset.
summerHome.directTitle: You discover. Local providers host you.
summerHome.directText: We do not sell travel packages. Discover the place, visit the provider's own site and book directly with them.
summerHome.finalText: Archipelago. Sauna. Nature. Food. Silence. Find your way to experience Finland.
summerHome.coastalTitle: Five coastal places to start with
summerHome.coastalText: Mathildedal, Naantali, Turku, Hanko and Åland reveal different sides of Finland: sea, nature, food, history and slow summer days.
